why: Both propose a similar density-based regional hedgehog and cover all three key brutal facts, but Analysis 1 comes closer to the key by naming the doom loop in its verdict, admitting the 'best at' circle may be empty, and putting 'stop competing on price without a cost edge' in its top stop-doing items. Analysis 2 is better on the decline mechanism, since it warns against ignoring the superstore shift and a parent sale, whereas Analysis 1 treats the superstore format as a hype risk.
